svg.title: find_drifting_entities and an entity's temporal solid
svg.desc: An agent ranks entities by temporal drift, moves onto the top one with goto and reads its temporal solid with get_solid. On the right, the entity's 22 active deformation slices are replayed in delta space: it sits beyond theta for its whole recorded history, then moves to its current position inside theta (its current delta_norm). Each slice's distance from the centroid is its real delta_norm_snapshot; the angular wander is illustrative.
svg.text: Beyond θ in every window, inside θ now: normalizing.
